bio.text: Fred Wellman, a Democrat from Wildwood, Missouri, won the 2026 Democratic primary for Missouri's 2nd Congressional District, defeating Joan VonDras.
He hosts the "On Democracy" podcast on the MeidasTouch network and was previously executive director of the Lincoln Project.
In announcing his campaign, he said he spent 22 years serving in the Army.

sources.title: Democratic candidate Wellman chides Rep. Wagner for her support of Iran war
Podcast host and Democrat Fred Wellman runs for Ann Wagner's congressional seat
